Create one editorial illustration for The Daily AI Pulse.

Placement: article hero, also used as a guide card. Output crop: wide landscape 16:9, high-resolution 2048 by 1152 or larger.
Subject: Part 2 — Build Your First RAG Application in TypeScript.
Verified context: The snapshot is the handoff between ingestion and questions. The document hash identifies the bytes we indexed; it does not certify who wrote them or whether the policy is current. After generation, the application checks that every returned source ID belongs to the selected context.
Visual idea: One blank paper slip drawn from a small stone archive along a terracotta guide channel, with a fine thread keeping its physical connection to the source. This is an abstract editorial metaphor for preserved provenance, not a literal technical architecture or proof of correctness.
Canonical composition: a low oblique three-quarter study of a compact dark stone archive holding upright blank cream folios. One cream slip extends into a low terracotta groove in front, and a single visible dark thread runs back to its source in the archive. Keep the whole assembly compact and centered. Avoid any desktop accessories.
Use the inspected story layout role: full-width image after article introduction, centered object-fit cover at 21:9 desktop and 16:9 mobile; guide cards use 3:2 and narrow rows square. Keep archive, selected slip and their connection clustered in the central half with generous warm negative space around them.
Art direction: a restrained contemporary editorial illustration with a quiet scientific or architectural sensibility. Use deliberate geometry, fine lines, subtle paper texture, and a single clear focal idea that remains legible at thumbnail size. Harmonize with warm canvas #F3EBDD, paper #FAF6EE, near-black ink #171B1A, muted gray #575D5B, and sparing terracotta #8A4B35. Spacious composition and strong contrast. Match the inspected production family: tactile chalky stone, blank matte paper, restrained terracotta, soft directional shadows and quiet material depth, editorial rather than glossy product advertising.
Do not produce a bare schematic, flowchart, wireframe, icon composition, or minimalist architecture diagram. The metaphor needs physical/spatial presence, substantial materiality, subtle depth and compositional hierarchy; fine lines support the solid forms.
No words, letters, numbers, labels, logos, interface elements, page header, footer, buttons, badges, charts with invented data, watermark, neon effects, robots, or generic glowing AI brains. Do not generate a headline, imitate a screenshot or depict a measured result. No border or frame. Do not add magnifying glasses, keys, gears, hands or people.
Deliver one clean coherent image, not a contact sheet or labeled panels.

technical_review.article_execution: Extracted the exact Markdown TS fences and workspace shell commands into a fresh disposable folder. Node 22.23.4: nine groups pass; ingestion, retrieval and no-evidence CLI paths pass. TypeScript 6.0.3 strict noEmit check passed using repository development types, not required by reader runtime.
technical_review.diagram: Both SVG variants rendered with CairoSVG and displayed. Checked labels/arrows against actual code. Mobile match branches bypass terminal no-evidence; retrieve mode does not enter model path. Desktop body labels increased to 24 SVG units and checked at 646px article-column width; snapshot arrows rerouted around section labels. Both final SVGs rendered and displayed.
technical_review.site_validation: npm run verify passed locally; draft route absent from dist and public guide list. Existing Zod deprecation hints remain unchanged. Browser attempt failed before page inspection: system Chromium socket() Operation not permitted; Playwright Chromium download was not a ZIP; cloud browser localhost returned ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED. No local browser/axe pass claimed.

editorial_findings_resolved: Kept TypeScript CLI scope distinct from existing FastAPI deployment tutorial.
Explained lexical no-match versus actual absence of evidence.
Separated ID-membership validation from factual support.
Labeled fake answers and live-model steps; no fabricated execution or benchmarks.
Documented line-based ID stability limits, post-read input caps and single-writer snapshot assumptions.
Retained English-only guide contract; no invented French review status.

Original committed source remains draft and its public detail/listing route is absent. No live browser inspection of the new article or axe pass is claimed.
